sentences.l2: 在现代城市里，越来越多的高楼开始种植蔬菜和水果。
sentences.l1: In modern cities, more and more tall buildings have started growing vegetables and fruit.

sentences.l2: 这些垂直农场不仅美化了环境，也对城市的可持续性发展有帮助。
sentences.l1: These vertical farms not only beautify the environment, but also help the sustainable development of the city.

sentences.l2: 城市规划者发现，有绿色植物的大楼更受人们欢迎。
sentences.l1: City planners have found that buildings with green plants are more popular with people.

sentences.l2: 因为这样，房地产价格有时会升高。
sentences.l1: Because of this, real estate prices sometimes rise.

sentences.l2: 住在城市里的人可以更容易地买到新鲜的蔬菜，这对粮食安全也有好处。
sentences.l1: People living in the city can buy fresh vegetables more easily, which is also good for food security.

sentences.l2: 虽然建设垂直农场需要很多投资，但长期来看，它能减少运输食物的成本。
sentences.l1: Although building vertical farms requires a lot of investment, in the long run, they can reduce the cost of transporting food.

sentences.l2: 蔬菜直接在城市里生产，不需要从很远的农村运来。
sentences.l1: Vegetables are produced directly in the city and do not need to be transported from far-away rural areas.

sentences.l2: 这样可以减少污染，也避免因为天气问题导致食物短缺。
sentences.l1: This can reduce pollution, and also avoid food shortages caused by weather problems.

sentences.l2: 一些公司已经开始投资这种农业项目。
sentences.l1: Some companies have already started investing in this kind of agricultural project.

sentences.l2: 他们认为，这是一种既能赚钱，又能保护环境的方式。
sentences.l1: They believe that this is a way that can both make money and protect the environment.

sentences.l2: 此外，垂直农场不受季节影响，每年都可以生产。
sentences.l1: In addition, vertical farms are not affected by the seasons and can produce every year.

sentences.l2: 这使得城市的食品供应更加稳定。
sentences.l1: This makes the city's food supply more stable.

sentences.l2: 有些人担心这种技术很复杂，但其实它主要依靠阳光、水和简单的机器。
sentences.l1: Some people worry that this technology is very complicated, but in fact it mainly relies on sunlight, water and simple machines.

sentences.l2: 农民可以在楼顶或阳台种菜，不需要大片土地。
sentences.l1: Farmers can grow vegetables on rooftops or balconies, and do not need large areas of land.

sentences.l2: 现在，不少城市都鼓励居民参与这种新型农业。
sentences.l1: Now, quite a few cities encourage residents to take part in this new type of agriculture.

sentences.l2: 虽然垂直农场不能完全替代传统农业，但它是一个重要的补充。
sentences.l1: Although vertical farms cannot completely replace traditional agriculture, they are an important supplement.

sentences.l2: 未来，随着技术进步，这类项目可能成为城市生活的一部分。
sentences.l1: In the future, with technological progress, this kind of project may become part of city life.

sentences.l2: 它们连接了农业、环保和经济发展，是城市现代化的一种表现。
sentences.l1: They connect agriculture, environmental protection and economic development, and are one expression of urban modernization.
